name: List All Late Fee Policies
description: Returns all late fee policies that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by the unique identifier of the late fee policy. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter by the date the late fee policy was last updated (from). All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by the unique identifier of the property.

queryFilters.name: page[number]
queryFilters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

queryFilters.name: page[size]
queryFilters.description: Page size for pagination. Default is 1000.

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of late fee policy objects

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the late fee policy

responseFields.name: data[].EligibleCharges
responseFields.description: The specific charges to which the late fee will be applied

responseFields.name: data[].GracePeriodType
responseFields.description: The type of Grace Period to enforce

responseFields.name: data[].GracePeriodValue
responseFields.description: A number of days after the charge, or a number of days into the following month.

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the late fee policy was last updated

responseFields.name: data[].OccupancyId
responseFields.description: When present, the Late Fee Policy belongs to a specific occupancy within a MFR property.

responseFields.name: data[].PolicyEffectiveOn
responseFields.description: The date at which the late fee policy will start

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: It is filled for both property-based and occupancy-based policies. PropertyId can be used to tie an occupancy-based policy to its MFR building.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
